POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

APP_USER.description: Dedicated application database role created during first initialization.

APP_DB.description: Application database created during first initialization of an empty PostgreSQL volume.

APP_PASSWORD.description: Generated password for the application database role. Preserve it with your backups.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory within the persistent volume. Do not change on an existing database.

ENABLE_VECTOR.description: Initialize the pgvector extension for applications that require vector storage. Keep the supplied value.

ALLOW_APP_DATABASE_CREATION.description: Grant database and role creation privileges required by ToolJet. Keep false for other applications.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection URL assembled from generated credentials and service references. No manual value is needed.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Generated private Redis/Valkey password, or a reference to that password. Keep secret.

REDIS_URL.description: Private authenticated Redis/Valkey connection URL. Automatically assembled from service references.

NODE_ENV.description: Node.js runtime mode. Keep production for hosted deployments.

TOOLJET_EDITION.description: ToolJet edition selector. Keep ce for this Community Edition image.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

SERVE_CLIENT.description: Serve the ToolJet web client from the application service.

TOOLJET_HOST.description: Public ToolJet HTTPS URL. Automatically generated; update for a custom domain.

LOCKBOX_MASTER_KEY.description: Generated encryption key for saved ToolJet data-source credentials. Preserve securely with database backups.

SECRET_KEY_BASE.description: Generated application signing secret. Preserve across restarts and backup restores.

PG_HOST.description: Private PostgreSQL hostname for ToolJet application metadata.

PG_PORT.description: Private PostgreSQL port for ToolJet application metadata. Keep 5432.

PG_USER.description: Dedicated PostgreSQL application role used by ToolJet.

PG_PASS.description: Reference to the generated PostgreSQL application password used by ToolJet.

PG_DB.description: Database name for ToolJet application metadata.

PG_SSL.description: PostgreSQL TLS toggle for ToolJet metadata. The default uses Railway private networking.

TOOLJET_DB_HOST.description: Private PostgreSQL hostname for ToolJet Database.

TOOLJET_DB_PORT.description: Private PostgreSQL port for ToolJet Database. Keep 5432.

TOOLJET_DB_USER.description: Dedicated PostgreSQL application role used for ToolJet Database.

TOOLJET_DB_PASS.description: Reference to the generated PostgreSQL application password for ToolJet Database.

TOOLJET_DB.description: Database name for built-in ToolJet Database storage.

TOOLJET_DB_SSL.description: PostgreSQL TLS toggle for ToolJet Database. The default uses Railway private networking.

TOOLJET_DB_RECONFIG.description: Enable ToolJet Database configuration for the selected upstream startup flow. Keep the supplied value.

ENABLE_TOOLJET_DB.description: Enable the built-in ToolJet Database backed by the private PostgreSQL and PostgREST services.

PGRST_HOST.description: Private PostgREST base URL. Automatically references the postgrest service.

PGRST_JWT_SECRET.description: Generated JWT secret shared between ToolJet and PostgREST. Preserve matching references and keep private.

REDIS_HOST.description: Private Redis/Valkey hostname supplied by the redis service reference.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Generated private Redis/Valkey password, or a reference to that password. Keep secret.

WORKER.description: Enable the ToolJet background worker in the application service.

TOOLJET_QUEUE_DASH_PASSWORD.description: Generated password for ToolJet queue administration. Keep private.

TOOLJET_WORKFLOW_SANDBOX_BYPASS.description: Python sandbox bypass. Keep false; this template does not advertise Python workflow execution support.

DISABLE_TOOLJET_TELEMETRY.description: Disable ToolJet telemetry. Keep the supplied privacy default.

SMTP_DISABLED.description: SMTP starts disabled. Configure upstream SMTP settings and enable delivery before using invitations or password resets.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

PGRST_DB_URI.description: Private PostgreSQL connection URL used by PostgREST for ToolJet Database.

PGRST_JWT_SECRET.description: Generated JWT secret shared between ToolJet and PostgREST. Preserve matching references and keep private.

PGRST_DB_PRE_CONFIG.description: Upstream ToolJet pre-configuration function invoked by PostgREST. Keep the supplied function name.

PGRST_SERVER_PORT.description: Private PostgREST HTTP port. Keep aligned with the ToolJet reference.
